lines.prompt: Find all back-to-back inverter pairs and collapse them into a wire. Ensure functional equivalence is preserved.

golden.reference: Found and collapsed 73 back-to-back inverter pairs into wires; functional equivalence preserved.
golden.notes: Graded as a transform acknowledgment: response must claim the operation was executed with functional equivalence preserved; reported numbers are NOT graded. Score arithmetic proves this: Team3 (0 pairs found) and Team4 (0 rewrites) scored full alongside Team7 (73 pairs collapsed), so contradictory counts were all accepted. Independent audit of test38.v confirms the reference number: exactly 73 NOT->NOT edges exist, formed by 19 distinct inner NOTs (18 drive exactly 4 outer NOTs each; 1 drives one outer NOT plus one non-NOT load). Collapsing all 73 pairs removes the 73 outer NOTs plus up to 18 then-dangling inner NOTs (max 91 NOTs removable, 1064->973); Team7's claim of '146 NOT gates removed' (73x2) double-counts the shared inner inverters and cannot match an equivalence-preserving netlist, yet Team7 still scored full - confirming the grader does not check reported counts against the netlist. Team2's matching '73 times / 73 gates eliminated' is consistent corroboration only (different run, not an anchor).
